note: From the Phase 4 dataset raw v2 files. texts: measured text whose ink (text.tok) or declared background (text.bg.tok) resolved to --accent, --accent-deep, --accent-strong, --accent-soft, --accent-tint or --tint in that job (as the screen's own profile). fails = p10 below AA (the rig's aa flag); failsMed = median below AA. themes = the lowest p10 per theme-mode. icons/graphics: svg icons and graphics whose paint equals the document's resolved --accent (raw) or --accent-deep. Text on accent gradients (hero) is not tagged by the rig (bg.img) and is covered by runtime.mjs.
